name: abakus-one-functions
description: Server-authoritative Cloud Functions for Abaküs One - Sprint 9F (docs/decisions.md ADR-026). Emulator-tested only; not deployed to any real Firebase project yet - see functions/README.md.

scripts.test:emulator: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions,auth "cd functions && npm test"
scripts.seed:dev-tenant: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions,auth "cd functions && node scripts/seed_dev_tenant.mjs"
scripts.seed:dev-takeaway-qr: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions,auth "cd functions && node scripts/seed_dev_tenant.mjs && node scripts/seed_dev_takeaway_qr.mjs"
scripts.seed:dev-table-qr: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions,auth "cd functions && node scripts/seed_dev_tenant.mjs && node scripts/seed_dev_reservation.mjs && node scripts/seed_dev_table_qr.mjs"
scripts.seed:dev-reservation: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions,auth "cd functions && node scripts/seed_dev_tenant.mjs && node scripts/seed_dev_reservation.mjs"
scripts.seed:dev-catalog: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions,auth "cd functions && node scripts/seed_dev_tenant.mjs && node scripts/seed_dev_catalog.mjs"
scripts.seed:dev-staff: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions,auth "cd functions && node scripts/seed_dev_tenant.mjs && node scripts/seed_dev_staff.mjs"
scripts.migrate:catalog: cd .. && dart run tool/export_menu_catalog.dart && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions,auth "cd functions && node scripts/seed_dev_tenant.mjs && node scripts/migrate_canonical_catalog.mjs"
scripts.seed:dev-all: cd .. && dart run tool/export_menu_catalog.dart && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions,auth "cd functions && node scripts/seed_dev_tenant.mjs && node scripts/seed_dev_takeaway_qr.mjs && node scripts/seed_dev_reservation.mjs && node scripts/seed_dev_table_qr.mjs && node scripts/seed_dev_staff.mjs && node scripts/migrate_canonical_catalog.mjs"
